excerpt: The Nab collaboration will perform a precise measurement of 'a', the electron-neutrino correlation parameter, and 'b', the Fierz interference term in neutron beta decay, in the Fundamental Neutron Physics Beamline at the SNS, using a novel electric/magnetic field spectrometer and detector design.
publisher: Nab Collaboration (D. Pocanic et al.) / arXiv
title: Nab: Measurement Principles, Apparatus and Uncertainties
